extName.description: The extension name. A brand, so it is the same in every locale.

extDescription.message: 매번 닫아야 했던 것들이 안 뜹니다. 광고와 추적, 쿠키 동의창, 누르지도 않은 팝업, 앱 설치 유도를 페이지에 닿기 전에 걸러내고, 그래도 남는 것은 눌러서 직접 지웁니다.
extDescription.description: Shown under the name in the store and in the extensions list. Capped at 132 characters per locale, and the store refuses the upload rather than truncating — scripts/verify-build.mjs checks it. Written per language rather than translated: this one leads with what a reader keeps closing, which is the same complaint in both but not the same sentence.
